name: Tablet customer sees the tester in the basket
fullName: features/tester_purchase.feature:Tablet customer sees the tester in the basket
description:
To try a paint colour at home before buying a full tin
As a Dulux customer
I want to add a tester for a chosen shade to my basket

The same basket check on a tablet (TC-23), at 768 px wide.

steps.name: Given a tablet customer has a tester for shade "Romantic Reverie" in the basket
And the basket includes tester "Dulux Colour Tester" for shade "Romantic Reverie"
And the basket shows the tester price "£2.90", delivery "Free" and order total "£2.90"
